items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: Maurice Justin and Hippolyte Francis playing with him.

ctx.x: Who would he have with him in those days?

Oh, let me see if I can remember now. It's been kind of his in my mind because I worked with Bill. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. What was Maurice's name? Maurice. What was Maurice's name? Maurice. Maurice Justin. Yeah. Maurice Justin and Hippolyte Francis playing with him.
